documented_probe: C-500da2a9 (estimate an average treatment effect to high accuracy): this task exercises the full capability — derive the backdoor adjustment set from a supplied DAG (excluding the instrument, mediator and collider), fit an outcome model flexible enough for a nonlinear/interactive DGP, compute the ATE by g-computation, and land within ±0.06 of the true effect on hidden studies.
notes: Failure modes probed directly: adjusting for the mediator/collider or failing to exclude the instrument dilutes or biases the estimate (far outside tolerance); an additive-linear outcome model misses the squared terms and treatment interactions (bias > tolerance); wrong number formatting/scale is rejected by the strict 6-decimal single-number format check. Hidden studies vary n, sigma, effect signs/strengths, column names and DAG topology (instrument-only-parent, confounder chain, binary/continuous confounder mixes), so hard-coding the visible estimate fails.
